info.description:
Real-time Solana memecoin intelligence from Cookin: token quality scores, bundle (coordinated wallet) detection, holder behavior, KOL positions, trader profiles, and deployer history.

Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Solana, no account or API key), or send a Pro API key as a Bearer token (1 SOL per 30 days, at https://cookin.fun/account/api-keys). A request with neither gets 402 with both options: the x402 offer in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and the Pro link in the body.
